raw_translation: Audio ni decoded na tena-encoded katika kivinjari chako; asili ni kamwe kupakuliwa au kubadilishwa. ZXQPH0000QXZ pato hutumia bundled encoder mitaa. M4A / AAC na OGG / Opus encoding kutegemea codecs inapatikana katika kivinjari chako. Re-encoding inaweza kupunguza ubora wa sauti, na matokeo inaweza kuwa kubwa; hakuna nakala inatoa isipokuwa ni ndogo. Hakuna fixed server faili-ukubwa cap, lakini kumbukumbu kifaa, kasi, bure kuhifadhi na kivinjari codec msaada ni vikomo vitendo. desktop au laptop ni kupendekezwa kwa ajili ya rekodi ndefu.
source: Audio is decoded and re-encoded in your browser; the original is never uploaded or changed. MP3 output uses a bundled local encoder. M4A/AAC and OGG/Opus encoding depend on codecs available in your browser. Re-encoding may reduce sound quality, and the result may be larger; no copy is offered unless it is smaller. There is no fixed server file-size cap, but device memory, speed, free storage and browser codec support are practical limits. A desktop or laptop is recommended for long recordings.
